propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError but core modules only catch urllib.error.HTTPError, causing exceptions to escape and fail soft-degradation handlers
deletion detection in outbound_differ._safe_get_issue silently breaks on DC because JIRAError does not match the HTTPError or URLError catch clauses
BackendHTTPError must be declared on the Backend port, subclass urllib.error.HTTPError to carry .code, and be adopted by all backends as the transport error contract
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving HTTP status codes
existing core exception handlers need no modification because BackendHTTPError is-a urllib.error.HTTPError and .code access remains valid by construction
Cloud urllib transport remains unmodified and unaffected, preserving the live-validated path
